boxes.meaning: throw oneself into, be absorbed in

examples.english: I immerse myself in researching this topic so deeply that I even forget to eat.
examples.traditional: 我全心投入研究呢個課題，連食飯都唔記得。

examples.english: When I write a report, I tend to engross myself in it and lose track of time.
examples.traditional: 我一寫報告就好投入，成日做到唔知幾點。
